description: Type the managed-API-keys gate. Calling the API key endpoints with an API key needs Daytona's "Managed API keys" feature, which Daytona enables per organization on request (https://www.daytona.io/docs/en/api-keys/); otherwise the API answers HTTP 403 "Managing API keys with an API key is not enabled for this organization" (observed live 2026-11-03 on POST and GET /api-keys).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Managing API keys with an API key (the manage:api_keys permission) is not enabled for this organization; Daytona enables it on request. Sign in as a user instead (HTTP 403).

message.includes: Managing API keys with an API key is not enabled
